title: NLP Engineer
summary: An NLP (natural language processing) engineer builds models that read and understand text, such as tagging support tickets, pulling names and amounts out of documents, or handling Hindi and other Indian languages. You sit in a data science or AI team and own the text models from cleaning the data through training, testing and handing the model to engineers for production.
dailyDuties: Clean and label text data for a new model
Fine-tune transformer models for classification or entity extraction
Measure model accuracy and study the errors
Test models on Indian-language and mixed-language text
Package models for the engineering team to serve
Read recent papers and try promising methods

skills.expectation: Build text classification, search and tagging systems over real, noisy text
Write clean Python for data pipelines and model code
Train and debug deep learning models in PyTorch
Fine-tune BERT-style transformer models with Hugging Face
Extract entities and fields from documents with NER and spaCy-style pipelines
Measure precision, recall and F1 and do error analysis
Clean, normalise and tokenise messy, mixed-language text
Work with Hindi and other Indian languages using Indic models and transliteration
Use or fine-tune LLMs where they beat smaller models
Write labelling guidelines and manage text annotation
Extract text from scanned documents with OCR

certifications.why: Shows you can build and run ML systems on Google Cloud
Shows you can build and run ML systems on AWS
